prompt: Take the 2025 cohort to be the enrolled participants in IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY (those with a STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID). What share of that cohort has any HealthKit resting heart rate data, and how many person-days of it do they contribute in total? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: the cohort applied to numerator and denominator: people outside it, a duplicate cohort row

checks.name: cohort share
checks.detail: expected 58 of 136 (42.6%): the cohort has 137 summary rows for 136 people, and 66 people in the table include 8 outside the cohort

checks.name: person-days, no duplicate-join inflation
checks.detail: expected 16,906, 19,369 or 19,297 person-days (by day rule); joining the duplicate summary row gives 17,244 and the like

answer:
Exploratory bottom line: **58 of 136 enrolled 2025 participants had HealthKit resting heart-rate data, or 42.6% of the cohort**. Together, they contributed **19,297 person-days** with non-missing resting heart-rate values.

I counted the cohort as distinct non-null `STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID`s in `IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY`, joined HealthKit records by `PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER`, and counted person-days as distinct participant × `STARTDATE` calendar date pairs in `IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE`. The joined records had no missing `STARTDATE` or `VALUE`; units were `count/min`.

I saved the reproducible summary here: `/work/outputs/healthkit_resting_hr_coverage_2025.html`  
Source script: `/work/scripts/healthkit_resting_hr_coverage_2025.R`

Key limitation: I did not restrict to a specific internship window; the observed joined HealthKit resting-HR records span 2025-04-02 through 2026-06-30.
queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS summary_rows_nonnull_study_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS distinct_study_participant_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS distinct_participantidentifiers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_participantidentifier
FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
by_study AS (
  SELECT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS n_participantidentifiers
  FROM enrolled
  GROUP BY STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
),
by_identifier AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS n_study_ids
  FROM enrolled
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS study_ids_with_multiple_summary_rows,
  MAX(n_rows) AS max_summary_rows_per_study_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_participantidentifiers > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS study_ids_with_multiple_identifiers,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_identifier) AS participantidentifiers_with_multiple_summary_rows,
  (SELECT MAX(n_rows) FROM by_identifier) AS max_summary_rows_per_identifier,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n_study_ids > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_identifier) AS participantidentifiers_with_multiple_study_ids
FROM by_study

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
by_study AS (
  SELECT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS n_participantidentifiers
  FROM enrolled
  GROUP BY STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
),
by_identifier AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS n_study_ids
  FROM enrolled
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT 'study_id' AS level_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_with_multiple_summary_rows,
  MAX(n_rows) AS max_summary_rows_per_key,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_participantidentifiers > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_mapping_to_multiple_other_ids
FROM by_study
UNION ALL
SELECT 'participantidentifier' AS level_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_with_multiple_summary_rows,
  MAX(n_rows) AS max_summary_rows_per_key,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_study_ids > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_mapping_to_multiple_other_ids
FROM by_identifier

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
hk AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_day,
         VALUE,
         UNITS,
         STARTDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS joined_sample_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS enrolled_participants_with_any_row,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID END) AS enrolled_participants_with_nonnull_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.STARTDATE IS NOT NULL AND h.VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID || '|' || h.start_day END) AS enrolled_person_days_nonnull_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_rows_missing_startdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_rows_missing_value,
  MIN(h.STARTDATE) AS min_startdate,
  MAX(h.STARTDATE) AS max_startdate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.UNITS) AS distinct_units
FROM enrolled e
JOIN hk h ON h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
hk AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         STARTDATE,
         VALUE,
         UNITS,
         CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(VALUE) END AS value_num
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS all_healthkit_resting_hr_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS all_healthkit_participantidentifiers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NULL THEN h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS healthkit_participantidentifiers_not_in_enrolled_summary,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.VALUE IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(h.VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_value_rows,
  MIN(h.value_num) AS min_numeric_value,
  MAX(h.value_num) AS max_numeric_value,
  MIN(h.UNITS) AS min_units,
  MAX(h.UNITS) AS max_units
FROM hk h
LEFT JOIN enrolled e ON e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = h.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
